nodes.title: Build Pattern: Multi-agent ADHD cognitive support system
nodes.metadata_json:
{"branch":"main","confidence":95,"prompt":"Create a multi-agent cognitive support system specifically designed for ADHD brains. The system should provide external executive function through specialized cognitive agents inspired by Brandon Sanderson's Stormlight Archive spren. Each user ("partner") gets their own constellation of agents that evolve their relationship over time.

Core principles:
- Different, not broken: ADHD brains operate on different physics
- External executive function: Pattern provides what ADHD brains need
- No shame spirals: Never suggest "try harder"
- Hidden complexity: "Simple" tasks are never simple
- Energy awareness: Attention depletes non-linearly

Inspired by MemGPT/Letta stateful agent architecture."}

{"branch":"main","confidence":95,"prompt":"Design a memory system inspired by MemGPT/Letta:
- Core blocks: Always in context (persona, human, active_context)
- Working memory: Swappable, can be pinned or ephemeral
- Archival memory: Long-term searchable storage

Key insight: The agent has limited context but can search its full history."}

nodes.metadata_json:
{"branch":"main","confidence":95,"prompt":"Major refactor to replace SurrealDB with SQLite + Loro CRDT + sqlite-vec.

Key drivers:
- SurrealDB complexity and type-safety issues
- Need for compile-time verified queries (sqlx)
- Loro CRDT provides versioned documents with time-travel
- sqlite-vec enables semantic search without external vector DB
- FTS5 for full-text search

Key architectural changes:
- Agent-scoped memory instead of user-scoped (prevents accidental overwrites)
- Explicit block sharing between agents
- Native coordination patterns instead of Letta dependency"}
